_comment: Plan 032 Prong B. One entry per registered LISTENING_TESTS id; one entry per speakerId the test's transcript declares (src/listening/tests/*.ts). 'voice' is an OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts voice name; 'gender'/'accent' restate the transcript's own ListeningVoiceHint so this file is reviewable on its own, without cross-referencing the transcript. OpenAI's TTS voices are American-accented regardless of the name chosen here — there is currently no accent selection on the API side, so 'accent' records what the transcript calls for, not a guarantee the voice reproduces it. Distinct voices are assigned within each section so speakers never collide; the maintainer should listen to a generated test end-to-end once and adjust voice choices here before regenerating, rather than trust this file blindly.
